articles.title: U.S. Treasury Department proposes GENIUS Act stablecoin rule
articles.snippet: The Treasury proposal would establish some of the core definitions and jurisdictions in the law Congress completed last year.

articles.title: The stablecoin yield clash that won't go away has banks, crypto battling over tradition
articles.snippet: The bankers want people kept in lower-yield deposits for the good of the financial system as it's existed for generations, and their argument is gaining ground.

articles.title: US Treasury moves forward with rules on GENIUS Act after July deadline
articles.snippet: The stablecoin bill signed into law last year is scheduled to go into effect in January 2027, potentially without finalized regulations from US government agencies.

articles.title: Galaxy lowers CLARITY Act odds to 10%
articles.snippet: Galaxy cited unresolved ethics, stablecoin yield and developer protection issues, along with a narrow Senate window when lawmakers return in September.

articles.title: Trump-Linked World Liberty Gets Conditional Bank Charter for USD1 Stablecoin
articles.snippet: The proposed World Liberty Trust Company would take over issuance of the USD1 stablecoin from BitGo.
